text: 围城里的人想逃出来，城外的人想冲进去，无论婚姻也罢，事业也罢,人生亦如此，钱钟书钱老先生的短短数语，虽说平淡，却把人生的千姿百态刻画得淋漓尽致。
en: Those within the besieged fortress wish to escape, while those outside wish to rush in; be it marriage or career, life is the same. Mr Zhongshu Qian's few brief words, though plain, portray the myriad forms of life most vividly.

text: 光阴飞速，带走的是青春的骄傲，留下的是岁月的无常，心中感慨未尽，不想转眼就要到而立之年，其中感叹，甚为心动，静下心来细细品味，回首过去，心中满是酸楚，上苍如此安排人生，却叫你我困扰一生，似乎生命的历程注定是一场修行。
en: Time flies swiftly; what it carries away is the pride of youth, what it leaves is the impermanence of the passing years. My heart's reflections are not yet spent when, before I know it, I am about to reach the age of thirty. The sighs within move me deeply; I calm my heart and savour them carefully, and looking back upon the past, my heart is filled with bitterness. Heaven arranges life in this way, yet it troubles you and me all our lives; it seems the journey of life is destined to be a kind of spiritual practice.

text: 生活累了，便想想采菊东篱下,悠然见南山的那份静意，那种超脱与自在将自己麻醉，用生活的七色光彩来装扮和充实自我。
en: When life grows wearisome, I think of that tranquillity of 'picking chrysanthemums beneath the eastern fence, calmly gazing upon the southern hills' — that detachment and ease intoxicate me, and I adorn and enrich myself with the seven-coloured splendour of life.

text: 年少时成长在乡村，那时虽被那份朴实真诚的多情所感染，却又向往都市的灯红酒绿，人潮涌动的繁华；而今，不想当真的面对这一切时，
en: I grew up in the countryside when I was young; though then I was moved by that simple, sincere and tender warmth, I nonetheless yearned for the city's bright lights and revelry, the bustling prosperity of surging crowds; but now, when I truly face all of this,

text: 又不仅为掩藏在物质文明外衣下那份淡漠的人情所困惑，金钱的铜臭味，噪声的污染时时刻刻穿墙透壁紧随着你我，久而久之便有了一种失落感,记得有一句话：
en: I am again puzzled not only by that indifferent human warmth hidden beneath the guise of material civilisation, but also by the copper stench of money and the pollution of noise that constantly penetrate the walls and follow closely upon you and me. Over time a sense of loss arose, and I recall a saying:

text: “人在拥有某种东西时，不觉得其珍贵，可一旦失去后就会感受其存在的价值”事实上，生活中我得到的同时,正意味着某种失去，但我不必去苟求，
en: "When one possesses something, one does not feel its preciousness, yet once it is lost one comes to appreciate the value of its existence." In truth, in life, to gain something means at the same time a certain loss, yet I need not make excessive demands,

text: 有句名言写道:人生，做下来，很不容易。
en: A well-known saying goes: to get through life is no easy matter.

text: 于是我在失去那份感受的时候，总向往着一份自我洒脱，有时寄托于工作去充实内心的一份需求，消除那份失落，可这样又是很机械运作，自己顿感茫然。
en: Thus, when I lose that feeling, I always long for a kind of easy detachment; sometimes I throw myself into work to satisfy an inner need and dispel that sense of loss, yet this too is but mechanical routine, and I am suddenly overcome with bewilderment.

text: 人其实是很简单的一个字，繁杂的只是做人的内涵，尽管他总是被写在历史的第一行，既然来到世间，你就得走别人的路，看别人曾看过的风景。
en: Man is in fact a very simple word; what is complicated is only the meaning of being human. Although he is always written in the first line of history, since you have come into this world, you must walk the paths others have walked and see the scenery others have seen.

text: 走在尘世间，冷落几度，忧伤几何，我需要的是无怨无悔，不喜不怒，唯有与自己和解，心态放平，感恩遇到的一切，走好自己的一生。
en: Walking through this mortal world, how often neglected, how much sorrow — what I need is to harbour no regret, to feel neither joy nor anger, only to make peace with myself, keep an even mind, be grateful for all I encounter, and walk my own life well.
